faq.t4: The main questions answered in one place. For individual circumstances, write to us with the subject and details.
faq.t5: Can I come alone if I do not know anyone?
faq.t6: Yes. Meeting new people is why we get together. Mention that it is your first time and we will explain where to meet and who to look for.
faq.t7: Is this a restaurant, festival or private party?
faq.t8: This is a friendly, open gathering for Ukrainians and friends. Invite your Spanish friends too: we share culture and meet different people. We share costs and relax together. It is not restaurant service: we may set the table and help cook together.
faq.t9: How much does it cost and what does it cover?
faq.t10: We share organisational costs rather than charge an admission fee. The contribution depends on attendance, menu, venue and transport. We explain the amount and what it covers before you confirm. There is no single price for every gathering.
faq.t11: When should I confirm and contribute?
faq.t12: The earlier, the better. We buy, marinate, vacuum-pack and prepare according to attendance. Late changes mean extra trips, shopping and costs. You may write on the last day, but availability must be confirmed.
faq.t14: No. Everyone brings water and drinks for themselves and their family. We do not sell drinks at the venue. You may bring food to share if you wish; agree it with the organiser first.
faq.t16: Yes. We bring a children’s tent, tunnel, mats, balls, rackets, drawing board, paper, pencils and chalk; equipment varies by trip. Children remain under their adults’ supervision. An activity leader is included only when stated in the announcement.
faq.t17: Do you accommodate allergies and dietary needs?
faq.t18: Tell us before we buy ingredients. We will discuss ingredients and alternatives. We cannot promise an allergen-free kitchen, so important restrictions must be discussed in advance.
faq.t19: What happens if it rains or gets windy?
faq.t20: We bring shelters, fixings and clips for sun and rain. In unsafe weather, we may reschedule or change the format. We will inform participants; check the organiser’s messages before travelling.
faq.t21: How do I get there without a car?
faq.t22: The route depends on the venue. For Las Graveras, Cercanías to La Rinconada may be an option; we will confirm the exact route. Mention if you need a lift. Transport cannot be guaranteed.
faq.t23: Will there be lights, music and seating?
faq.t24: We plan tables, benches, chairs, a speaker, lamps and string lights for the evening. Equipment depends on the venue and group size. Tell us in advance about accessibility or seating requirements.
faq.t25: What if my plans change after contributing?
faq.t26: Write as soon as possible. Agree cancellation and refund terms before paying: some money may already have been spent on food and preparation. There is no universal refund rule for all events.
faq.t27: Can I help or offer my talent?
faq.t28: Yes: with shopping, transport, shelters, the table, cooking and cleaning. We also welcome musicians, hosts, craftspeople, photographers and people with ideas. Choose the subject in the form.
faq.t29: Can you organise a gathering in my city?
faq.t30: Yes, anywhere with enough interest and a suitable venue. Choose a destination or tell us your city and roughly how many people are interested. This does not reserve a place or confirm an event.
faq.t31: What happens after I fill in the form?
faq.t32: The form prepares a message with your name, contact, subject and details. You review it and send it yourself to the organiser in Telegram. Preparing the message does not confirm attendance.
faq.t33: Why do you need my name and contact details?
faq.t34: So the organiser knows who is writing, can reply and arrange your participation. Contact fields are not published or stored here. Future meetup updates are optional and require separate consent.
